witnesses.separates: Piece B of the middle band turns by a diagonal step, with no empty column inside it. The concept and $Adjacency8 keep the band as one piece and leave it in place; $PieceComponent and $OneColor take its two 4-connected halves as two pieces and lift the second half and piece C one row so that each continues the previous one.

The first band holds a color-2 hook and a color-4 cell touching it. The concept and $PieceComponent take the band as one piece whose end is the color-4 cell in row 1, and drop piece B one row; $OneColor takes the color-4 cell as its own piece, lifts it to row 0 beside the hook's end, and leaves B in place.

The first piece is a U whose end, in its last column, lies in its start row. The concept attaches B at that end in row 1 and leaves it in place; $EndFarthestRow takes the last column's cell in row 2, farthest from the start row, and drops B one row.

The first piece's path ends at (0,1), outside its last column, so no cell of the last column is a path end. The concept is undefined; $EndPathEnd attaches B in row 0, the row of that end, and $EndFarthestRow takes the same row as the cell farthest from the start row.
Each piece ends one row below its start, so the third piece reaches below the strip. The concept keeps the three rows and drops the cell past them; $GrowFrame adds a fourth row that holds it.

Train 0's input with colors 0 and 5 swapped, on a field of 5. The concept, at background 0, takes the whole grid as one piece with no path start and is undefined; the derived background is 5, and the branch gives train 0's output with the same swap.

A single color-1 cell and a color-3 bar stand in neighboring columns with no empty column between them, and no cell of one touches the other. The concept takes the run of columns as one piece starting at the color-1 cell and leaves it in place; $PieceComponent takes them as two pieces and lifts the bar to row 0 beside the color-1 cell; with $EndPathEnd it is undefined, as the one-cell piece has no path end besides its start.
